title: Pebbled and suede leather
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of leather: rounded pebble grain with a crease network, fine creases, pores, fold wrinkles, burnished wear, a cracked old finish or a brushed suede nap. Use for car seats, sofas, bags, saddles, jackets, book covers and armchairs.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python leather_grain.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: grain_cells
parameters.meaning: Pebbles across the tile width: low values give a coarse bag grain, high values a fine one.

parameters.name: grain_depth
parameters.meaning: How deep the creases between pebbles are.

parameters.name: fine_grain
parameters.meaning: Small creases inside the pebbles, at about 2.3 times the pebble frequency (dropped where they would be finer than two pixels).

parameters.name: pores
parameters.meaning: Density and depth of the small pores of the hide.

parameters.name: wrinkles
parameters.meaning: Long creases from folding and use.

parameters.name: wear
parameters.meaning: Burnished, lighter and glossier high points, in patches.

parameters.name: cracking
parameters.meaning: Cracks in an old surface finish, showing the darker leather below.

parameters.name: nap
parameters.meaning: Suede nap: fine fibres hide the grain and brushing leaves light and dark patches.

parameters.name: gloss
parameters.meaning: Shine of the finish: 0 matte, 1 polished.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Black car-seat leather: fine even pebble grain with a satin finish.

presets.name: saddle_brown
presets.description: Smooth tan saddle leather: shallow grain, wrinkles and burnished wear.

presets.name: pebbled_navy
presets.description: Navy handbag leather with a coarse, deep pebble grain.

presets.name: aged_oxblood
presets.description: Oxblood club-chair leather with a cracked finish and worn patches.

presets.name: suede_tan
presets.description: Tan suede: brushed nap with light and dark patches.

limits: The grain is a warped cellular pattern with noise creases, a stylized stand-in for real hide structure; species-specific grains (ostrich, crocodile, snake) are out of scope. Wrinkles are noise crests, not simulated folds, and the suede nap is a fibre-noise and brushing-patch approximation without directional sheen. Wear and cracks are noise-driven and spread evenly rather than following seams or edges. Details finer than two pixels are dropped at small sizes. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced. Colours are artistic, not measured.
technique_references: Worley cells on a torus with edge distance for pebbles and creases
Rounded caps from the distance to each cell's feature point
Zero crossings of gradient noise as fine creases
Two-scale domain warping of the cell field
Ridged fractal noise for fold wrinkles
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
